Stone MD – this is the first application for patients with kidney stones encompassing the most important aspects of this disease.

This application will calculate your individual risk of kidney stone recurrence based on the scientifically proven formula which you can find in the "TEST" section, moreover it will optimize your diet according to the type of kidney stones you have and calculate the calories in the food you eat - in the "FOOD» section. 

Normalization of your drinking regimen is very important for kidney stone prophylaxis. Tool which is going to help you with this located in the "WATER BALANCE" section.

Those who are dissolving stones (urate or struvite) will get a special section "pH DIARY", which allows you to enter the pH of urine directly into the smartphone, with  graphic representation if needed.

Given the high percentage of forgotten kidney stents, which get encrusted with time, removal of which requires additional surgery, we created a section called "STENT RADAR" where you can set the date of the stent installation and the date of its planned removal, and your phone does the rest - it will remind you of the need to visit the doctor.

Your feedback with request of adding some new foods in the application can be found in the "CONTACT US" section.

Downloading this application on your phone you also get the opportunity to receive the most current medical news from the world of kidney stones as a push notifications from us of course if you want them!
 
The main thing to remember is – this application will not replace your doctor, but will greatly facilitate his care about you and will help reduce the risk of a possible stone recurrence.
